heading: You're already paying for sport, entertainment, facilities and services. Customers can't act on what they don't know about.
subhead: You've already paid for live sport, played through the week and not just weekends. You've booked artists to perform and have a stage show running for a month. There's also the quiz on the quieter nights.

cards.title: The show's on. Nobody in the bar knows.
cards.text: Dinner & a show. The bar's half-full - are they here for the show or the match. The dining room's half-full. I hope between them, they're all going to the show.

cards.title: One speaker system, four kick-offs
cards.text: The Bar is half-full. The feature game gets the house sound, but there are three more on.  Fans of the "other" games are likely to leave for somewhere where they can connect.

cards.title: Nobody knew it was on
cards.text: Trivia, music and comedy live and die on a poster. Two items have to be change at short notice - The Comedian is ill but can do the music night and vice versa.
